why: All three checks pass, so the finding survives — but half of it is wrong and the wording of the rest needs correcting. (1) QUOTE: verbatim at typescript.md line 1396, a standalone one-line paragraph under `### SDKInformationalMessage`; all three of its sentences are in the quoted string, so nothing later on the line reverses it. `local_command_output` is a separate type at line 4581. (2) CODE: accurate. packages/shared/src/agent/backend/claude/event-adapter.ts:622-656 — adaptSystem is an if/else over `init`, `compact_boundary`, `status`+`compacting`, `task_notification`, with no trailing else; `case 'system'` at :224-226 is the only route for system messages and claude-agent.ts has zero direct `subtype`/`'system'` handling. `grep -ran` (NUL-safe) gives 0 hits for `local_command_output` repo-wide and 0 code hits for the `'informational'` subtype (the 11 `informational` hits are unrelated prose in comments about connector rows). Both are declared in node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/sdk.d.ts:3559 and :3589 at 0.3.183. Two wording defects: adapt() at :196-201 DOES emit a generic `SDK message: system` debug line for every system message, so 'dropped without a debug line' is false at the type level (what is dropped without any trace is the subtype, content, level and reason); and 'silent turn' was not tested — the CLI still emits a `result` after the block, so the user may get a generic completion or 'Query failed' rather than literal silence. What is certain is that the reason is discarded. (3) CONSEQUENCE, informational half — CONFIRMED, with a positive control. The block is reachable by design: hook-decision-contract.ts:40-50 lists UserPromptSubmit in TOP_LEVEL_BLOCK_EVENTS and :238-242 in ALWAYS_TERMINAL_BLOCK_EVENTS. Under Claude the automation is handed to the SDK, not run host-side: claude-agent.ts:1288 takes `automationSystem.buildSdkHooks()` and :1602 merges it into the SDK `hooks` option; hooks-automation.ts:1621-1658 builds a callback per matcher for EVERY configured event including UserPromptSubmit, and automationResultToSdkHookResult (:1673-1683) maps a block to `{continue:false, decision:'block', reason}`. The reason then exists only in whatever the CLI emits back — per the quoted line, the informational message — which adaptSystem drops. There is no second channel: SessionManager.reportHookErrors (:5421-5450, the role:'info' warning path) is wired only into the `executeAgentEvent` arm of trackAgentAutomationSystem (:5384-5391), NOT into the buildSdkHooks arm (:5392-5405), and hookErrors covers non-blocking hook failures anyway, not decisions. The positive control is the same event on three sibling backends, all of which run it host-side and surface the reason: pi-agent.ts:6430-6433 (`blocked: reason || 'A <event> hook blocked this prompt.'`), codex-agent.ts:462-467 (`yield { type: 'error', message: reason }`), nestor-cloud-agent.ts:275-278. `grep -an 'UserPromptSubmit|emitAutomationEvent'` over claude-agent.ts returns 0 hits, so ClaudeAgent is the one backend with no host-side prompt gate. (4) CONSEQUENCE, local_command_output half — REFUTED, sibling-subsystem shape. Slash commands in this fork are first-party and resolved server-side (see verdict f073); claude-agent.ts:1662-1674 hands the SDK exactly one command, SDK_SLASH_COMMANDS = ['compact'], whose output is a compact_boundary, already handled. The CLI will therefore never emit local_command_output for a Nessy session, so 'local slash-command output for display' describes an unreachable message, not a gap. (5) Not one of the nine owner decisions in 2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md §3 (none touches the Claude event adapter or hook feedback), and not a rebrand or dropped-subscription product difference — the Claude backend ships and is user-enableable, `NESSY_FEATURE_PROVIDER_CLAUDE` being off by default only narrows the blast radius.
correctedState: Narrow the row to the `informational` subtype only. adaptSystem (event-adapter.ts:622-656) handles init, compact_boundary, status/compacting and task_notification and returns for every other system subtype; the generic `SDK message: system` debug line at :200 records the type but never the subtype, content, level or reason. Consequence: under the Claude backend a UserPromptSubmit automation that blocks is handed to the SDK as `{continue:false, decision:'block', reason}` (claude-agent.ts:1288/1602 → hooks-automation.ts:1673-1683), and the reason comes back only on the dropped `informational` message, so the user is told nothing about why the prompt was refused — where Pi (pi-agent.ts:6430), Codex (codex-agent.ts:462) and Nestor Cloud (nestor-cloud-agent.ts:275) each surface it as an error. 'Silent turn' is unverified: the SDK still emits a result, so the visible outcome may be a bare completion or a generic error rather than nothing at all. Drop the `local_command_output` half: this fork resolves slash commands first-party and sends the SDK only SDK_SLASH_COMMANDS = ['compact'] (claude-agent.ts:1665), so that subtype is unreachable here.
